description: This file defines a static class 'GrainTypeGenerator' within the 'UnitTests.StorageTests.Relational.TestDataSets' namespace. It contains interfaces and classes for different grain types with various key types, as well as methods for retrieving grain type names based on generic parameters. It also includes a dictionary mapping key types to grain types for dynamic type selection.

classes.name: GrainTypeGenerator
classes.description: A static utility class for generating and retrieving grain type names based on generic key types.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the assembly qualified name of a grain type based on the generic key type.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Overloaded method that returns the assembly qualified name of a grain type based on key and grain type parameters.
